'''Ray Hefferlin''' (1929 – March 7, 2015) was a physicist and research professor. He taught at [[Southern Adventist University]] and conducted extensive research on [[periodic systems of small molecules]].

==Biography==

Hefferlin was born in France, in Paris, and moved with his father to the United States when he was seven.<ref name=obit/> His research was in the area of [[periodic systems of small molecules]].<ref name=sau/> He taught at [[Southern Adventist University]] in [[Collegedale, Tennessee]], from 1955 until his death.<ref name=sau>{{cite web |url= http://www1.southern.edu/academics/academic-sites/physics/Faculty/rayhefferlin.html|title=Dr. Ray Hefferlin|author=Southern Adventist University|work=southern.edu|accessdate=23 March 2015}}</ref> He received the Pegram Award from the Southeastern Section of the [[American Physical Society]] and the Professor of the Year Gold Medal Award of the [[Council for the Advancement and Support of Education]].<ref name=sau/>

In 1979, Hefferlin published a periodic ordering of all of the [[diatomic molecule]]s that could result from combinations of the first 118 elements of the [[periodic table]]; unlike earlier such systems, such as that of [[C. H. Douglas Clark]], it was multi-dimensional. According to ''[[Scientific American]]'', it allowed accurate prediction of the characteristics of diatomic molecules.<ref name=Scerri>{{cite web|last1=Scerri|first1=Eric|title=The evolution of the periodic system|url=http://www.scientificamerican.com/article/the-evolution-of-the-periodic-system/|publisher=[[Scientific American]]|accessdate=April 8, 2015}}</ref>

Hefferlin died on March 7, 2015, in Collegedale.<ref name=obit>{{cite web|url=http://www.timesfreepress.com/obits/2015/mar/22/ray-hefferlin/62966/|title=Obit - Ray Hefferlin - Times Free Press|work=timesfreepress.com|accessdate=23 March 2015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://spectrummagazine.org/article/2015/03/24/colleagues-students-and-friends-remember-physicist-ray-hefferlin|title=Colleagues, Students and Friends Remember Physicist Ray Hefferlin}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.adventistreview.org/church-news/story2468-ray-hefferlin,-prominent-physicist-and-sau-professor,-dead-at-85|title=Ray Hefferlin, Prominent Physicist and SAU Professor, Dead at 85 &#124; Adventist Review|date=26 March 2015}}</ref>
